rejected_experiment.method: Prepare bundled root-local schema references as anchors at import using the locked public jsonschema and referencing interfaces. Keep the default resolver for unsupported schema shapes.

hosted_observation.source: Use the authenticated original and private attribution indexed by the M0-132 feedback diagnostic locator.

local_experiment.worker_scope: Real worker launch through exit with synthetic input and verified replies. Independent medians exclude a warmup per arm and use four measurements per arm. Raw independent samples and results are in the retained review. The one-shot source-row path starts a new worker and pays preparation at the handshake.
local_experiment.boundary_scope: Both codecs matched public values, bytes and errors. The actual source-row worker accepted 65,535 and 65,536 byte replies and returned RESOURCE_LIMIT one byte above the cap.

decision: Retain the protected validator. The original 274-vector test saves 0.514 seconds locally. The added startup cost repeats on ordinary fresh CSV source-row and folder-refresh workers. Reusing one market worker across 32 pages showed a benefit, while the actual user workload mix and its end-to-end gain remain unmeasured.
reopen_when: Revisit only if profiling a representative product workload, such as chart history paging across many requests in one reused market worker, shows protocol reference resolution materially delays user-visible completion. Measure the actual requests-per-worker distribution and end-to-end latency, including cold first response, ordinary one-shot CSV source-row and folder refresh, repeated operations, and retained memory. Any new candidate must preserve the protocol and improve the targeted product workload within the measured one-shot latency and memory budgets.
qualification: The supported experiment and the earlier private profiler prototype are distinct. This Linux-local evidence establishes the investigation result. Native results and the comparable multi-PR hosted timing qualification for M0-104 remain separate.
